### Josiah’s Final Battle
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/josiahs-final-battle
Passage: 2 Chronicles 35:22
Points:
- Josiah chose to confront Pharaoh Neco at Megiddo even though Egypt was not marching against Judah.
- God spoke a genuine warning through the pagan king, but Josiah disguised himself and disobeyed.
- This fatal failure ended Josiah's life, yet Scripture still remembers him as an obedient, godly ruler.
- Even the best earthly kings fall short, pointing to Jesus Christ as the only perfectly faithful King.
- Believers are called to pursue persistent obedience while resting in Christ's imputed righteousness.

### Josiah and Picking the Wrong Fight
Author: Grace to You
Site: Grace to You
URL: https://www.gty.org/blogs/B160701/josiah-and-picking-the-wrong-fight
Passage: 2 Chronicles 35:20-24
Points:
- Despite a lifetime devoted to godly reform, Josiah foolishly inserted himself into a foreign war.
- God communicated directly through Neco to warn him, but Josiah ignored the counsel and entered battle.
- A single reckless decision abruptly ended his reign at thirty-nine and left his nation and family vulnerable.
- Not every conflict is worth fighting, especially when driven by impulse or ego.
- Christians must avoid foolish distractions and prioritize their primary, God-given responsibilities.
